text: なんびき　あずけても　ただ　だし　こまめに　つかうと　いいよ！

structure.jp: なんびき　あずけても
structure.en: no matter how many you deposit

structure.jp: こまめに　つかうと　いいよ！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.span: なんびき　あずけても
patterns.explanation: A question word followed later by the て-form plus も means 'no matter how many'. なんびき あずけても = 'however many you deposit'.

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A verb plus といい is a friendly piece of advice, 'it's good to do this'. こまめに つかうと いい = 'you should use it often'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a statement gives it as a reason, with a feeling of 'and besides'. ただ だし = 'it's free, so'.
